components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary operational command with one-step emerald feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; background: var(--accent-solid, #059669); color: var(--accent-contrast, #ffffff); font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-solid-hover, #047857); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Bordered command for secondary or reversible actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #d6d3d1); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--surface-primary, #ffffff); color: var(--text-secondary, #44403c); font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f5f5f4); color: var(--text-primary, #1c1917); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Explicit destructive action without decorative urgency.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--danger-border, #fca5a5); border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--danger-text, #b91c1c); font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: var(--danger-soft, #fef2f2); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-danger:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Stable-height field for prompts, filters, and configuration.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--text-muted, #57534e); font: 500 12px/16px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #d6d3d1); border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 12px; background: var(--field-bg, #fafaf9); color: var(--text-primary, #1c1917); font: 400 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--text-muted, #57534e); } .ds-field:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent-solid, #059669); outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.55); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Prompt Chip
components.description: Compact prompt-helper tag with restrained active feedback.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #d6d3d1); border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; background: var(--surface-primary, #ffffff); color: var(--text-secondary, #44403c); font: 500 12px/16px system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-solid, #059669); background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.08); color: var(--accent-solid-hover, #047857); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: App Surface
components.description: Flat bordered panel for one coherent operational section.
components.html:
Prompt

Generation and edit requests share one workflow.
components.css: .ds-surface { border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #d6d3d1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; background: var(--surface-primary, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #1c1917); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-surface h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-surface p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted, #57534e); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-surface:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent-solid, #059669); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Compact product identity and predictable workspace commands.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 56px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #e7e5e4); padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--app-bg, #fafaf9); color: var(--text-muted, #57534e); font: 500 14px/20px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; margin-right: auto; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--text-primary, #1c1917); font-weight: 600; } .ds-brand-mark { display: inline-flex; width: 28px; height: 28px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent-solid, #059669); color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav button { min-height: 40px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; } .ds-nav button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f5f5f4); color: var(--text-primary, #1c1917); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.65); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gallery Card
components.description: Signature image object with stable media, compact metadata, and touch-safe actions.
components.html: Generated image1024 × 1024 / gpt-image-2
components.css: .ds-gallery-card { overflow: hidden; width: 280px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #d6d3d1); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-primary, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #1c1917); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-gallery-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); } .ds-gallery-media { aspect-ratio: 1; background: var(--surface-secondary, #f5f5f4); } .ds-gallery-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 12px 8px; } .ds-gallery-copy strong { font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-gallery-copy span { color: var(--text-muted, #57534e); font-size: 11px; line-height: 16px; } .ds-gallery-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 0 8px 8px; } .ds-gallery-actions button { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-muted, #57534e); } .ds-gallery-actions button:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #f5f5f4); color: var(--accent-solid, #059669); } .ds-gallery-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(52, 211, 153, 0.65); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: GPT Image Panel is a restrained operational workspace. Its visual system keeps the user's prompt, configuration, task state, preview, and image library in one continuous field of attention. Neutral stone and zinc surfaces carry most of the interface; Operational Emerald appears only where a decision, focus state, or active operation needs a clear signal. The interface is quiet, disciplined, and operator-focused. Density is welcome when it improves scanning and repeated action, but every control must remain predictable and legible. The system explicitly rejects the neon creative-toy aesthetic: high-frequency animation, exaggerated gamification, and visually loud feedback are forbidden.
keyCharacteristics: Calm neutral surfaces in both light and dark themes.
Compact controls with stable 40px heights and 44px touch targets where icons stand alone.
Border-led hierarchy, with shadows reserved for overlays and meaningful lift.
Precise state feedback for remote and asynchronous work.
Responsive structures that preserve workflow order from desktop to mobile.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Operational Emerald is reserved for primary action, active state, focus, and success. Do not spread it across passive decoration.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Light and dark themes must preserve the same hierarchy and semantics even when their absolute colors differ.

rules.name: The Interface-First Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a display font, fluid type scale, negative letter spacing, or decorative capitalization into product controls.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A resting page section does not receive a shadow. If an element is neither overlaying content nor responding to interaction, use a border or tonal layer instead.

dos: Do preserve the prompt → assistant → preview → gallery workflow order across viewport sizes.
Do use Operational Emerald for primary action, active state, focus, and success.
Do use neutral borders and tonal surfaces as the default hierarchy mechanism.
Do keep common controls at 40px and standalone icon targets at least 44px × 44px.
Do provide precise loading, success, error, empty, and disabled states.
Do maintain WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, visible keyboard focus, accessible names, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't make the product feel like a neon creative toy.
Don't use high-frequency animation, exaggerated gamification, or visually loud feedback.
Don't introduce decorative gradients, glowing accents, or multiple competing signal colors.
Don't add shadows to resting page sections or nest decorative cards inside cards.
Don't use oversized display typography, fluid font sizing, or promotional hero composition in the working interface.
Don't let mobile layouts reorder the core workflow, overflow horizontally, or shrink icon targets below 44px.
